title: A photo that carries words is toned itself for them to read (image.tone), the least it takes and within half, or refused; a saved image's tone may change later
steps: S1: toneForWords dark on a flat mid-tone photo (150,120,90), on a dark one (30,25,20), on a bright cream one (244,239,230); light on a dark grey one (40,40,40); dark on a PNG cut-out.
S2: agentImageRecipe with tone dark and with tone grey; makeAgentImage with tone dark on the mid-tone and on the cream photo.
S3: amendsPlan of a saved image given a tone, its tone changed, its photo changed with a tone, its crop changed with a tone.
expect: S1: the mid-tone darkens by less than 10 % to ≤ the 4.5:1 ground for white, same size, JPEG, new hash; the dark one is unchanged; the cream one is refused AGENT_DEMO_IMAGE_TONE_UNREACHABLE naming a calmer, darker photo; the grey lightens to ≥ the ground for black within half; the PNG is skipped as transparent.
S2: tone dark is kept; grey is refused with 'image.tone is "dark"'; makeAgentImage tones the mid-tone and refuses the cream with its own code.
S3: tone set and tone changed pass; photo or crop changed fail.
evidence: Local rounds 27–31 (WordPress JA Restaurant): white words over the place's photos failed looks-finished; filter:brightness written into the block failed native-structure, an overlay colour in global styles failed look-kept.
fence: TONE (dark p85 ≤ 1.05/4.5−0.05, light p15 ≥ 0.175, limit 0.5); toneForWords; AGENT_DEMO_IMAGE_TONE_UNREACHABLE; amendsPlan untoned

tests: a photo that carries words is toned the least it takes for them to read, within half, or refused
a saved image's tone may be set or changed later; its photo and crop may not
